concept: Secrets Manager: storing and auto-rotating credentials
tests: Which service is built for storing DB credentials with scheduled automatic rotation and retrieval at runtime.
expected: AWS Secrets Manager — native automatic rotation (RDS integration), the app retrieves the secret at runtime. Triggers: "database credentials", "automatically rotate", "retrieve at runtime".
why_not: Parameter Store standard — no built-in automatic rotation; S3 — not a secrets store; KMS manages encryption keys, not application secrets.
